newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas rice crop condition improves slightly.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas rice crop condition improves slightly.

text.p: The Arkansas rice crop improved slightly last week to 75 percent good to excellent as of Sunday, above the 74 percent in that category the previous week, according to the Arkansas Agricultural Statistics Service.
The soybean crop was 60 percent good to excellent, below the 64 percent in that category the previous week.
The weather was hot and humid most of the week with scattered showers in the northern part of the state early in the week and in the southern part of the state for most of the week.
Soil moisture supplies were eight percent very short, 50 percent short, 41 percent adequate and one percent surplus.
Forty-five percent of the cotton crop was setting bolls, below the 90 percent of a year ago and below the 68 percent five-year average.
The soft red winter wheat harvest was 98 percent complete, below the 100 percent of a year ago and below the 100 percent average pace.
